  "use strict";
  function inspectWav(bytes, mime = "audio/wav") {
    if (!/^audio\/(wav|wave|x-wav)(;|$)/i.test(mime)) throw new Error(`Expected WAV MIME, received ${mime}`);
    const v = new DataView(bytes.buffer, bytes.byteOffset, bytes.byteLength);
    const tag = (n) => String.fromCharCode(...bytes.slice(n, n + 4));
    if (bytes.length < 44 || tag(0) !== "RIFF" || tag(8) !== "WAVE" || v.getUint32(4, true) + 8 !== bytes.length) throw new Error("Invalid RIFF/WAVE length or header");
    let rate = 0, channels = 0, bits = 0, block = 0, byteRate = 0, dataSize = 0;
    for (let offset = 12; offset + 8 <= bytes.length; ) {
      const size = v.getUint32(offset + 4, true), start = offset + 8;
      if (start + size > bytes.length) throw new Error("Truncated WAV chunk");
      if (tag(offset) === "fmt ") {
        if (size < 16 || v.getUint16(start, true) !== 1) throw new Error("Expected PCM WAV master");
        channels = v.getUint16(start + 2, true);
        rate = v.getUint32(start + 4, true);
        byteRate = v.getUint32(start + 8, true);
        block = v.getUint16(start + 12, true);
        bits = v.getUint16(start + 14, true);
      }
      if (tag(offset) === "data") dataSize += size;
      offset = start + size + size % 2;
    }
    if (![1, 2].includes(channels) || rate < 8e3 || rate > 192e3 || ![8, 16, 24, 32].includes(bits) || block !== channels * bits / 8 || byteRate !== rate * block || dataSize <= 0 || dataSize % block) throw new Error("Invalid WAV format or empty audio");
    return { sampleRate: rate, channels, bits, duration: dataSize / byteRate };
  }
  function stitchWavs(clips, options, random = Math.random) {
    const { minGap, maxGap, holdSeconds } = options;
    if (!clips.length) throw new Error("No current recordings to stitch.");
    if (![minGap, maxGap, holdSeconds].every(Number.isFinite) || minGap < 0 || maxGap < minGap || maxGap > 10 || holdSeconds < 1 || holdSeconds > 60) throw new Error("Gaps must be 0–10 seconds; payment hold must be 1–60 seconds.");
    const format = inspectWav(clips[0].bytes);
    const block = format.channels * format.bits / 8, byteRate = format.sampleRate * block;
    const pieces = [], timings = [];
    let size = 0;
    const append = (bytes2) => {
      size += bytes2.length;
      if (size > 256 * 1024 * 1024) throw new Error("Stitched WAV exceeds the 256 MiB export limit. Export one voice at a time.");
      pieces.push(bytes2);
    };
    for (const [index, clip] of clips.entries()) {
      const info = inspectWav(clip.bytes);
      if (info.sampleRate !== format.sampleRate || info.channels !== format.channels || info.bits !== format.bits) throw new Error(`Incompatible WAV format for ${clip.id}. All clips must have the same sample rate, channels and bit depth.`);
      const start = size / byteRate;
      const view2 = new DataView(clip.bytes.buffer, clip.bytes.byteOffset, clip.bytes.byteLength);
      for (let offset2 = 12; offset2 + 8 <= clip.bytes.length; ) {
        const length = view2.getUint32(offset2 + 4, true);
        if (String.fromCharCode(...clip.bytes.slice(offset2, offset2 + 4)) === "data") append(clip.bytes.slice(offset2 + 8, offset2 + 8 + length));
        offset2 += 8 + length + length % 2;
      }
      let gapAfter = 0;
      if (index < clips.length - 1) {
        const sample = random();
        if (!Number.isFinite(sample) || sample < 0 || sample > 1) throw new Error("Invalid random gap value.");
        const gap = minGap + sample * (maxGap - minGap);
        gapAfter = Math.round(Math.max(gap, clips[index + 1].paymentHoldBefore ? holdSeconds : 0) * format.sampleRate) / format.sampleRate;
        const silence = new Uint8Array(Math.round(gapAfter * byteRate));
        if (format.bits === 8) silence.fill(128);
        append(silence);
      }
      timings.push({ id: clip.id, start, duration: info.duration, gapAfter });
    }
    const bytes = new Uint8Array(44 + size + size % 2), view = new DataView(bytes.buffer);
    const tag = (offset2, text) => [...text].forEach((c, i) => bytes[offset2 + i] = c.charCodeAt(0));
    tag(0, "RIFF");
    view.setUint32(4, bytes.length - 8, true);
    tag(8, "WAVE");
    tag(12, "fmt ");
    view.setUint32(16, 16, true);
    view.setUint16(20, 1, true);
    view.setUint16(22, format.channels, true);
    view.setUint32(24, format.sampleRate, true);
    view.setUint32(28, byteRate, true);
    view.setUint16(32, block, true);
    view.setUint16(34, format.bits, true);
    tag(36, "data");
    view.setUint32(40, size, true);
    let offset = 44;
    for (const piece of pieces) {
      bytes.set(piece, offset);
      offset += piece.length;
    }
    return { bytes, timings, ...inspectWav(bytes) };
  }
  const esc = (value) => value.replace(/[&<>"']/g, (c) => ({ "&": "&amp;", "<": "&lt;", ">": "&gt;", '"': "&quot;", "'": "&#39;" })[c]);
  const decode = (src) => Uint8Array.from(atob(src.slice(src.indexOf(",") + 1)), (c) => c.charCodeAt(0));
  const blobUrl = (bytes, mime) => URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([bytes], { type: mime }));
  function mountWalkthrough(root2, data) {
    const steps = new Map(data.steps.map((s) => [s.id, s]));
    let routeKey = data.story ? "recommended" : "full";
    let current = (data.story?.recommendedPath ?? data.path)[0], history = [], complete = /* @__PURE__ */ new Set(), routeIds = data.story?.recommendedPath ?? data.path, view = data.story ? "intro" : "steps";
    let audio = null, timer, busy = "", status = "", run = 0;
    const audioUrls = /* @__PURE__ */ new Map();
    const results = /* @__PURE__ */ new Map();
    const gapDrafts = /* @__PURE__ */ new Map();
    const key = (s, a) => `${s.id}/${a.id}`;
    const step = () => steps.get(current);
    const position = () => routeIds.indexOf(step().parent ?? current);
    const done = () => !step().requiredAction || (complete.has(`${current}/${step().requiredAction}`) || transcriptRead.has(`${current}/${step().requiredAction}`));
    const nextId = () => !data.story ? step().next ?? step().parent ?? routeIds[position() + 1] : step().parent ?? (step().next && routeIds.includes(step().next) ? step().next : routeIds[position() + 1]);
    const chapterRoute = (id) => data.path.filter((key2) => steps.get(key2).chapter === id);
    const transcriptRead = /* @__PURE__ */ new Set();
    function writeUrl() {
      if (!data.story) return;
      const url = new URL(location.href);
      url.searchParams.delete("chapter");
      url.searchParams.delete("route");
      if (view !== "intro") {
        url.searchParams.set("route", routeKey);
        url.searchParams.set("chapter", step().chapter);
      }
      url.hash = view === "intro" ? "overview" : view === "outcome" ? "outcome" : `step-${current}`;
      try {
        window.history.replaceState(null, "", url);
      } catch {
      }
    }
    function showView(next) {
      stop();
      view = next;
      status = "";
      if (next === "intro") history = [];
      writeUrl();
      render();
    }
    function beginRoute(key2, entry, ids) {
      history = [];
      navigate(entry, false, ids, key2);
    }
    function stop() {
      run++;
      clearTimeout(timer);
      timer = void 0;
      busy = "";
      finishWait = void 0;
      if (audio) {
        const outgoing = audio;
        audio = null;
        outgoing.onended = outgoing.onplay = outgoing.onpause = outgoing.onerror = null;
        outgoing.pause();
        outgoing.removeAttribute("src");
        outgoing.load();
        outgoing.remove();
      }
    }
    function navigate(to, remember = true, nextRoute = routeIds, nextRouteKey = routeKey) {
      const target = steps.get(to);
      if (!target) return;
      const main = target.parent ?? to;
      if (!nextRoute.includes(main)) {
        nextRoute = chapterRoute(target.chapter);
        nextRouteKey = target.chapter;
      }
      if (!nextRoute.includes(main)) return;
      if (remember && view === "steps") history.push({ id: current, routeIds: [...routeIds], routeKey });
      stop();
      routeIds = [...nextRoute];
      routeKey = nextRouteKey;
      current = to;
      view = "steps";
      status = "";
      writeUrl();
      render();
      root2.querySelector("#step-title")?.focus({ preventScroll: true });
    }
    function restart() {
      stop();
      for (const result of results.values()) {
        URL.revokeObjectURL(result.wav);
        URL.revokeObjectURL(result.report);
      }
      results.clear();
      gapDrafts.clear();
      complete.clear();
      transcriptRead.clear();
      history = [];
      routeKey = data.story ? "recommended" : "full";
      routeIds = data.story?.recommendedPath ?? data.path;
      current = routeIds[0];
      view = data.story ? "intro" : "steps";
      status = "";
      writeUrl();
      render();
      root2.querySelector("#step-title, #story-title")?.focus({ preventScroll: true });
    }
    function update() {
      const next = root2.querySelector("#next");
      if (next) next.disabled = !nextId() && !data.story || !done() || !!busy;
      const skip = root2.querySelector("#skip-wait");
      if (skip) {
        skip.hidden = !busy;
        skip.onclick = () => finishWait?.();
      }
      const message = root2.querySelector("#action-status");
      if (message) message.textContent = status;
      root2.querySelectorAll("[data-action]").forEach((button) => button.disabled = !!busy);
      root2.querySelectorAll("[data-action]").forEach((button) => button.classList.toggle("completed", complete.has(`${current}/${button.dataset.action}`)));
    }
    async function play(source, description, completionKey) {
      stop();
      const token = run;
      const element = document.createElement("audio");
      audio = element;
      element.id = "audio-player";
      element.controls = true;
      element.preload = "auto";
      element.src = source;
      element.setAttribute("aria-label", description);
      const host = root2.querySelector("#media-host");
      host.replaceChildren();
      host.hidden = false;
      const label = document.createElement("p");
      label.className = "media-caption";
      label.textContent = description;
      host.append(label, element);
      const halt = document.createElement("button");
      halt.className = "quiet";
      halt.textContent = "Stop audio";
      halt.onclick = () => {
        stop();
        host.hidden = true;
        status = "Audio stopped. You can play it again.";
        update();
      };
      host.append(halt);
      element.onended = () => {
        if (audio !== element) return;
        if (completionKey) complete.add(completionKey);
        status = "Playback finished. Continue when you are ready.";
        update();
      };
      element.onplay = () => {
        if (audio === element) {
          status = "Playing audio. Use the player to pause or replay.";
          update();
        }
      };
      element.onpause = () => {
        if (audio === element && !element.ended) {
          status = "Audio paused.";
          update();
        }
      };
      element.onerror = () => {
        if (audio === element) {
          status = "This browser could not play the embedded recording. Try another browser.";
          update();
        }
      };
      try {
        await element.play();
        if (token !== run) element.pause();
      } catch {
        if (token === run) {
          status = "Playback did not start. Press play in the audio controls to retry.";
          update();
        }
      }
    }
    let finishWait;
    async function act(action) {
      if (busy) return;
      const s = step(), actionKey = key(s, action);
      try {
        if (action.kind === "navigate") return navigate(action.to);
        if (action.kind === "complete") {
          complete.add(actionKey);
          const to = action.to ?? nextId();
          if (to) navigate(to);
          else {
            status = "Step complete.";
            update();
          }
          return;
        }
        if (action.kind === "play") {
          const asset = data.assets[action.asset];
          if (!audioUrls.has(action.asset)) audioUrls.set(action.asset, blobUrl(decode(asset.src), "audio/wav"));
          return await play(audioUrls.get(action.asset), asset.description, actionKey);
        }
        if (action.kind === "simulate") {
          stop();
          busy = actionKey;
          status = action.waiting;
          update();
          const token = run;
          if (action.waitingScreen) {
            const image = root2.querySelector(".screen img");
            image.src = data.assets[action.waitingScreen].src;
            image.alt = data.assets[action.waitingScreen].description;
            root2.querySelectorAll(".hotspot").forEach((button) => button.style.visibility = "hidden");
          }
          const finish = () => {
            if (token !== run) return;
            clearTimeout(timer);
            timer = void 0;
            busy = "";
            finishWait = void 0;
            complete.add(actionKey);
            if (action.to) navigate(action.to);
            else {
              status = action.ready;
              render();
            }
          };
          finishWait = finish;
          timer = setTimeout(finish, action.durationMs);
          update();
          return;
        }
        if (action.kind === "stitch") {
          stop();
          const options = gapDrafts.get(actionKey) ?? { minGap: action.minGap, maxGap: action.maxGap, holdSeconds: action.holdSeconds };
          const result = stitchWavs(action.clips.map((c) => ({ id: c.id, bytes: decode(data.assets[c.asset].src), paymentHoldBefore: c.paymentHoldBefore })), options);
          const previous = results.get(actionKey);
          if (previous) {
            URL.revokeObjectURL(previous.wav);
            URL.revokeObjectURL(previous.report);
          }
          const report = { title: data.title, disclosure: data.disclosure, clips: action.clips.map((c) => ({ id: c.id, asset: c.asset })), options, duration: result.duration, timings: result.timings };
          results.set(actionKey, { wav: blobUrl(result.bytes, "audio/wav"), report: URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([JSON.stringify(report, null, 2)], { type: "application/json" })), duration: result.duration, filename: action.filename });
          complete.add(actionKey);
          status = `Created a ${result.duration.toFixed(2)} second WAV from the embedded clips.`;
          render();
        }
      } catch (error) {
        status = error.message;
        update();
      }
    }
    function render() {
      const s = step(), index = position(), next = nextId();
      const branding = data.branding ?? { name: "Guided walkthrough", caption: "INTERACTIVE DEMO", footer: "Explore at your own pace." };
      if (data.story && view !== "steps") {
        const story = data.story;
        if (view === "intro") {
          root2.innerHTML = `<header class="topbar"><a class="brand" href="#" id="home"><span class="brand-symbol" aria-hidden="true">◈</span><span>${esc(branding.name)}<small>PRODUCT STORY</small></span></a>${data.homeUrl ? `<a class="all-demos" href="${esc(data.homeUrl)}">← All demos</a>` : ""}</header><main class="story-card"><img class="story-cover" src="${esc(data.assets[story.openingAsset].src)}" alt="${esc(data.assets[story.openingAsset].description)}"><section><p class="eyebrow">${esc(story.audience)}</p><h1 id="story-title" tabindex="-1">${esc(story.title)}</h1><p class="story-problem">${esc(story.problem)}</p><dl class="story-facts"><dt>Who this is for</dt><dd>${esc(story.persona)}</dd><dt>What you will see</dt><dd>${esc(story.demonstrates)}</dd><dt>Outcome</dt><dd>${esc(story.outcome)}</dd></dl><p class="disclosure">${esc(data.disclosure)}</p><div class="story-actions"><button class="primary story-start" id="story-start">${esc(story.entryButton)}</button><button class="secondary" id="story-full">Explore the full instruction path</button></div><h2>Choose a chapter</h2><div class="story-chapters">${story.chapters.map((c) => `<button class="secondary" data-story-chapter="${c.id}"><strong>${esc(data.chapters.find((x) => x.id === c.id).title)}</strong><span>${esc(c.outcome)}</span>${c.preparedContext ? `<small>Starting context: ${esc(c.preparedContext)}</small>` : ""}</button>`).join("")}</div></section></main>`;
          root2.querySelector("#story-start").onclick = () => beginRoute("recommended", story.recommendedPath[0], story.recommendedPath);
          root2.querySelector("#story-full").onclick = () => beginRoute("full", data.path[0], data.path);
          root2.querySelectorAll("[data-story-chapter]").forEach((button) => button.onclick = () => {
            const chapter = story.chapters.find((c) => c.id === button.dataset.storyChapter);
            beginRoute(chapter.id, chapter.entry, chapterRoute(chapter.id));
          });
          root2.querySelector("#story-title")?.focus({ preventScroll: true });
        } else {
          const chapter = story.chapters.find((c) => c.id === routeKey);
          const ending = chapter?.ending ?? (chapter ? { changed: chapter.outcome, saw: "Inspect the retained states in this chapter.", limitations: data.disclosure, nextStep: "Replay the chapter or choose another route.", evidenceStep: chapter.entry, evidenceLabel: "Replay this chapter" } : story.ending);
          const evidence = ending.evidenceStep ?? (chapter?.entry || routeIds.at(-1));
          const activity = [...routeIds.flatMap((id) => steps.get(id).actions.filter((a) => complete.has(`${id}/${a.id}`)).map((a) => `${a.label}${a.kind === "simulate" ? " (simulation)" : a.kind === "complete" ? " (prepared walkthrough)" : ""}`)), ...routeIds.flatMap((id) => steps.get(id).actions.filter((a) => transcriptRead.has(`${id}/${a.id}`)).map((a) => `Transcript reviewed: ${a.label} (no listening or acoustic approval claimed)`))];
          const retained = [...results.entries()].filter(([key2]) => routeIds.includes(key2.split("/")[0]));
          root2.innerHTML = `<header class="topbar"><a class="brand" href="#" id="home"><span class="brand-symbol" aria-hidden="true">◈</span><span>${esc(branding.name)}<small>OUTCOME</small></span></a><button id="overview" class="quiet">← Story overview</button><button id="restart" class="quiet">Restart</button></header><main class="story-card outcome-card"><section><p class="eyebrow">${esc(chapter?.title ?? (routeKey === "full" ? "Full instruction path" : "Recommended route"))} · OUTCOME</p><h1 id="story-title" tabindex="-1">${esc(chapter?.outcome ?? story.outcome)}</h1><dl class="story-facts"><dt>Prepared context and workflow</dt><dd>${esc(ending.changed)}</dd><dt>Retained evidence to inspect</dt><dd>${esc(ending.saw)}</dd><dt>Evidence limits</dt><dd>${esc(ending.limitations)}</dd><dt>Actions completed this session</dt><dd id="session-actions">${activity.length ? activity.map(esc).join("; ") : "No completing actions recorded. Opening this outcome does not complete skipped evidence."}</dd></dl><p class="story-next"><strong>Next step</strong><br>${esc(ending.nextStep)}</p><div class="story-actions"><button class="secondary" id="outcome-evidence">${esc(ending.evidenceLabel ?? "Inspect retained evidence")}</button>${retained.map(([, result]) => `<a class="secondary" href="${result.wav}" download="${result.filename}">Download current WAV ↓</a>`).join("")}<button class="primary" id="story-again">Explore another chapter</button></div></section></main>`;
          root2.querySelector("#overview").onclick = () => showView("intro");
          root2.querySelector("#story-again").onclick = () => showView("intro");
          root2.querySelector("#outcome-evidence").onclick = () => navigate(evidence, false);
          root2.querySelector("#restart").onclick = restart;
          root2.querySelector("#story-title")?.focus({ preventScroll: true });
        }
        root2.querySelector("#home").onclick = (event) => {
          event.preventDefault();
          showView("intro");
        };
        return;
      }
      root2.innerHTML = `<header class="topbar"><a class="brand" href="#" id="home"><span class="brand-symbol" aria-hidden="true">◈</span><span>${esc(branding.name)}<small>${esc(branding.caption)}</small></span></a><div class="header-actions">${data.homeUrl ? `<a class="all-demos" href="${esc(data.homeUrl)}">← All demos</a>` : ""}<button id="restart" class="quiet">Restart</button></div></header>
      <main><div class="intro"><div><p class="eyebrow">${esc(data.subtitle)}</p><h1>${esc(data.title)}</h1></div><span class="offline">Standalone HTML · offline</span></div>
      ${data.story ? `<button id="overview" class="quiet story-overview">← Story overview</button>${data.story.chapters.find((c) => c.id === s.chapter)?.preparedContext ? `<p class="prepared-context">${esc(data.story.chapters.find((c) => c.id === s.chapter).preparedContext)}</p>` : ""}` : ""}
      <p class="disclosure">${esc(data.disclosure)}</p><nav class="chapters" aria-label="Walkthrough chapters">${data.chapters.map((c, i) => `<button data-chapter="${c.id}" aria-current="${s.chapter === c.id ? "step" : "false"}"><span>${i + 1}</span>${esc(c.title)}</button>`).join("")}</nav>
      <div class="workspace"><section class="screen-panel" aria-label="Captured screen"><div class="screen-toolbar"><span>${data.showStateIds ? `CAPTURED STATE / ${esc(s.id)}` : "INTERACTIVE WALKTHROUGH"}</span><button id="zoom" class="quiet" aria-pressed="false">Enlarge screen</button></div><div class="screen-scroll"><div class="screen"><img src="${esc(data.assets[s.screen].src)}" alt="${esc(data.assets[s.screen].description)}" draggable="false">${s.actions.filter((a) => a.hotspot).map((a) => {
        const r = a.hotspot;
        return `<button class="hotspot" data-action="${a.id}" style="left:${r.x}%;top:${r.y}%;width:${r.width}%;height:${r.height}%" aria-label="${esc(a.label)}"><span aria-hidden="true">↗</span></button>`;
      }).join("")}</div></div><p class="screen-hint">Click a highlighted control, or use the matching button beside the screen.</p></section>
      <section class="guide" aria-labelledby="step-title"><p class="eyebrow">${s.parent ? "OPTIONAL DETAIL" : `STEP ${index + 1} OF ${routeIds.length}`}</p><h2 id="step-title" tabindex="-1">${esc(s.title)}</h2><p class="instruction">${esc(s.instruction)}</p><div class="actions">${s.actions.map((a) => `<button class="${a.kind === "navigate" ? "secondary" : "primary"}" data-action="${a.id}">${esc(a.label)}${complete.has(key(s, a)) ? " ✓" : ""}</button>`).join("")}</div>${s.actions.filter((a) => a.kind === "play").map((a) => a.kind === "play" ? `<details class="transcript"><summary>Read transcript: ${esc(a.label)}</summary><p>${esc(data.assets[a.asset].description)}</p><button class="secondary" data-transcript="${a.id}">Continue using transcript</button><p>No listening or acoustic approval is recorded by this action.</p></details>` : "").join("")}
      ${s.actions.filter((a) => a.kind === "stitch").map((a) => {
        if (a.kind !== "stitch") return "";
        const options = gapDrafts.get(key(s, a)) ?? a, result = results.get(key(s, a));
        const fields = a.clips.length > 1 ? `<fieldset class="gap-options" data-gap-action="${a.id}"><legend>Silence between clips</legend><label>Minimum seconds<input type="number" data-gap="minGap" min="0" max="10" step="0.1" value="${options.minGap}"></label><label>Maximum seconds<input type="number" data-gap="maxGap" min="0" max="10" step="0.1" value="${options.maxGap}"></label></fieldset>` : "";
        return `${fields}${result ? `<div class="result" data-result-action="${a.id}"><b>${result.duration.toFixed(2)} seconds · ${a.clips.length} ${a.clips.length === 1 ? "clip" : "clips"}</b><button class="secondary" data-result-play="${a.id}">Play ${a.clips.length === 1 ? "saved" : "stitched"} audio</button><a href="${result.wav}" download="${result.filename}">Download WAV ↓</a><a href="${result.report}" download="${result.filename.replace(".wav", "-timings.json")}">Download timing report ↓</a></div>` : ""}`;
      }).join("")}<button id="skip-wait" class="quiet" hidden>Skip presentation wait</button><div id="media-host" hidden></div><p id="action-status" role="status" aria-live="polite">${esc(status)}</p><div class="navigation"><button id="back" class="secondary" ${history.length ? "" : "disabled"}>← Back</button><button id="next" class="secondary" ${!next && !data.story || !done() ? "disabled" : ""}>${s.parent ? "Return to walkthrough" : next ? "Continue →" : data.story ? "See the outcome →" : "Complete ✓"}</button></div>${s.requiredAction && !done() ? '<p class="required-hint">Complete the highlighted action to continue. Chapter buttons let you inspect other sections.</p>' : ""}</section></div>
      <footer><span>${index + 1} / ${routeIds.length} steps in this route</span><span>${esc(branding.footer)}</span></footer></main>`;
      root2.querySelector("#restart").onclick = restart;
      root2.querySelector("#home").onclick = (event) => {
        event.preventDefault();
        restart();
      };
      root2.querySelector("#back").onclick = () => {
        const previous = history.pop();
        if (previous) {
          navigate(previous.id, false, previous.routeIds, previous.routeKey);
        }
      };
      root2.querySelector("#next").onclick = () => {
        if (next && done() && !busy) navigate(next);
        else if (data.story && !next && done() && !busy) showView("outcome");
      };
      root2.querySelector("#overview")?.addEventListener("click", () => showView("intro"));
      root2.querySelectorAll("[data-chapter]").forEach((button) => button.onclick = () => {
        const chapter = data.story?.chapters.find((c) => c.id === button.dataset.chapter);
        const first = chapter?.entry ?? data.path.find((id) => steps.get(id).chapter === button.dataset.chapter);
        if (first) navigate(first, true, data.story ? chapterRoute(chapter.id) : data.path, chapter?.id ?? "full");
      });
      root2.querySelectorAll("[data-action]").forEach((button) => button.onclick = () => {
        const action = s.actions.find((a) => a.id === button.dataset.action);
        if (action) void act(action);
      });
      root2.querySelectorAll("[data-transcript]").forEach((button) => button.onclick = () => {
        stop();
        transcriptRead.add(`${s.id}/${button.dataset.transcript}`);
        status = "Transcript reviewed; no listening or acoustic approval claimed.";
        update();
      });
      root2.querySelectorAll("[data-result-play]").forEach((button) => button.onclick = () => {
        const result = results.get(`${s.id}/${button.dataset.resultPlay}`);
        if (result) void play(result.wav, "Stitched audio from the embedded example clips");
      });
      root2.querySelectorAll("[data-gap]").forEach((input) => input.oninput = () => {
        const action = s.actions.find((a) => a.id === input.closest("[data-gap-action]")?.dataset.gapAction);
        if (action?.kind !== "stitch") return;
        const options = gapDrafts.get(key(s, action)) ?? { minGap: action.minGap, maxGap: action.maxGap, holdSeconds: action.holdSeconds };
        options[input.dataset.gap] = input.value.trim() ? Number(input.value) : NaN;
        gapDrafts.set(key(s, action), options);
        const result = results.get(key(s, action));
        if (result) {
          stop();
          root2.querySelector("#media-host").hidden = true;
          URL.revokeObjectURL(result.wav);
          URL.revokeObjectURL(result.report);
          results.delete(key(s, action));
          complete.delete(key(s, action));
          root2.querySelector(`[data-result-action="${action.id}"]`)?.remove();
          status = "Settings changed. Create a new stitched WAV.";
          update();
        }
      });
      root2.querySelector("#zoom").onclick = (event) => {
        const button = event.currentTarget;
        const enlarged = root2.querySelector(".screen-scroll").classList.toggle("enlarged");
        button.setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(enlarged));
        button.textContent = enlarged ? "Fit screen" : "Enlarge screen";
      };
      const screen = root2.querySelector(".screen");
      screen.onclick = (event) => {
        if (!event.target.closest("button")) {
          status = "Use a highlighted control to follow this prepared walkthrough.";
          update();
        }
      };
      update();
    }
    function restoreLocation() {
      stop();
      history = [];
      if (data.story) {
        const params = new URLSearchParams(location.search), hash = location.hash;
        const match = hash.match(/^#step-([a-z][a-z0-9-]*)$/), state = match && steps.get(match[1]);
        const requested = params.get("route") ?? params.get("chapter");
        const chapter = data.story.chapters.find((c) => c.id === requested);
        if (hash !== "#overview" && (state || chapter || requested === "recommended" || requested === "full")) {
          routeKey = requested === "full" || requested === "recommended" ? requested : chapter?.id ?? state.chapter;
          routeIds = routeKey === "recommended" ? data.story.recommendedPath : routeKey === "full" ? data.path : chapterRoute(routeKey);
          if (hash === "#outcome") {
            current = routeIds.at(-1);
            view = "outcome";
            writeUrl();
            render();
          } else if (!hash || state) navigate(state ? state.id : chapter?.entry ?? routeIds[0], false);
          else showView("intro");
        } else showView("intro");
      } else render();
    }
    restoreLocation();
    window.addEventListener("hashchange", restoreLocation);
    const unload = () => {
      stop();
      for (const url of audioUrls.values()) URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
      for (const result of results.values()) {
        URL.revokeObjectURL(result.wav);
        URL.revokeObjectURL(result.report);
      }
    };
    const pagehide = (event) => {
      if (event.persisted) stop();
      else unload();
    };
    window.addEventListener("pagehide", pagehide);
    return { destroy: () => {
      unload();
      window.removeEventListener("pagehide", pagehide);
      window.removeEventListener("hashchange", restoreLocation);
      root2.replaceChildren();
    } };
  }
  const root = document.getElementById("walkthrough");
  if (root) {
    try {
      mountWalkthrough(root, JSON.parse(document.getElementById("walkthrough-data").textContent));
    } catch {
      root.textContent = "The walkthrough definition could not be loaded. Rebuild the standalone file from its source definition.";
    }
  }
  exports.mountWalkthrough = mountWalkthrough;
  Object.defineProperty(exports, Symbol.toStringTag, { value: "Module" });
  return exports;
})({});
</script></body></html>
